messages:
Zara (Ops): Postmortem follow-up: we need clear public comms, owners for the customer packet, and to make sure all remediation items are owned/timed. I can stitch the tracker but need owners.
Matt (SRE): I'll take the internal RCA and turn each remediation into a JIRA with owners. Draft RCA in 48h, final in 96h. Will flag any similar incidents for recurrence analysis.
Ivy (Support): Support wants a 2-line status answer + a short FAQ and canned replies within 24h. Also need guidance on which customers should get the private packet vs the public summary.
Rafael (Legal): Public copy must avoid conjecture. Confirm impact, restoration, and data exposure only. Private RCAs ok to share under NDA or contract; Support should log all requests.
Pri (Product): Suggested status page blurb: "Text-generation service experienced degraded performance from 01:05-01:40 UTC. Service restored. No customer data exposed. We are investigating and will publish a detailed update within 72 hours." Simple and non-technical.
Zara (Ops): Good. Ownership suggestions: Zara approves + publishes status copy; Ivy builds canned replies; Rafael legal reviews customer packet; Matt owns internal RCA + tickets; Pri tracks product follow-ups if recurrence confirmed.
Matt (SRE): I'll also include SLO impact (p95, error rate, throughput) and link prior incidents. If recurrence exists, suggest a focused resiliency sprint.
Ivy (Support): I'll prepare canned replies and escalation language for enterprise customers. ETA 18h after I get the one-paragraph external summary.
Rafael (Legal): I'll review the one-paragraph and canned replies within 12h. For RCA requests, Support should require contract channels/NDA.
Zara (Ops): Action list in-thread:
- PRI: finalize 1-paragraph external summary (due +6h)
- IVY: canned replies & FAQ (due 18h)
- MATT: internal RCA draft + ticketize actions (draft 48h, final 96h)
- RAFAEL: legal review of customer packet + replies (12-24h)
- ZARA: publish status page once legal and support confirm (24h)
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-401 marked RESOLVED by deploy pipeline.
Matt (SRE): I'll post links to historical incidents and add recurrence notes within 24h.
Ivy (Support): I'll coordinate an afternoon sync for handoffs and will attach canned replies to this thread once ready.
Zara (Ops): Thanks everyone. Keep updates here so we have one canonical thread. We'll run a 20-min check-in tomorrow at 09:30 UTC to confirm ticket owners. :thumbsup:
